_comment: Jurisdiction shortcuts for the legal-mode onboarding.
Copy this file to legal-jurisdictions.local.json and list the
jurisdictions you actually work in. The .local.json copy is gitignored,
so a public release never discloses where you do business.
An empty list is a valid and safe state: the onboarding then asks for
jurisdiction as free text, which anchors nothing at all.
These shortcuts are a convenience only. Jurisdiction is never defaulted
and never pre-selected - see rules and modes/definitions/legal-mode.yaml.
